verdict.rationale: The skill uses the open Agent Skills format (a folder with a SKILL.md) and claims it works in any agent that supports skills. Install instructions cover Claude Code (plugin marketplace commands), the Claude app (upload under Settings → Capabilities → Skills) and a generic copy-the-folder path, but nothing specific for other harnesses. Missing for 10: explicit per-harness instructions for Codex, Cursor and other agents, and hands-on confirmation that it works outside Claude.
